description: Public standings of a RankFuel leaderboard (radio listener board): station, contest, open/closed, ranked listeners (display names, towns, points; ties share a rank), and a ready-to-quote answer with the leader. Use when someone asks "who is winning/leading …" and has an rfwin.uk/lb/<id> link. No token needed. Free, no key.

boardId.description: Leaderboard id (10 characters) or its public link, e.g. https://rfwin.uk/lb/abc123defg

top.description: How many places to return, 1-100 (default 10; listeners tied at the cutoff are included)

name: get_leaderboard
